title: Route-local support reuse equivalence and affected population measurement
acceptance_criteria: Do cached and uncached routes preserve outcomes and exact waypoints while reducing repeated support work and observing changed world geometry between attempts?
Do obstruction-safe fixture placement and authenticated per-case join/render evidence establish useful parrot and mixed population measurements?

checks.rationale: Focused lead-owned native route equivalence and work-reduction fixtures. Exercise identical cached/uncached route implementation, non-direct searches and world changes between attempts. Report filtered selected/total and pass/failure counts; tags are not isolation. This is a diagnostic for an unaccepted optimization, not full-suite readiness.
covers: Do cached and uncached routes preserve outcomes and exact waypoints while reducing repeated support work and observing changed world geometry between attempts?

checks.rationale: Isolated real-client 100-parrot capture of support-cache hits versus computations, actual collision work, route durations, tick/frame distributions and separate JVM GC. Preserve owned-process admission and per-case join/log/JFR evidence. Fixture location may change, so this alone is not a controlled before/after timing comparison.
covers: Do cached and uncached routes preserve outcomes and exact waypoints while reducing repeated support work and observing changed world geometry between attempts?
Do obstruction-safe fixture placement and authenticated per-case join/render evidence establish useful parrot and mixed population measurements?

checks.rationale: 40 animals, eight each bat/kobold/parrot/hamster/cow. R33 failed before spawning on existing station-floor headroom obstruction. Try only bounded preflighted camera-facing candidates without clearing station blocks, body/camera teleportation or timeout increases; retain exact failure if none is safe. Short stationary windows cannot establish prolonged growth, jumping, native visual quality, manual readiness or owner acceptance.
